description: One key hands over to another. Signed by the old key and then by the new, so neither can be replaced without the other. What the old key was vouched for passes to the new from this record on.

details.description: Issuer-defined detail: up to 64 named scalars. Nothing in it is interpreted by the base kinds, and nothing in it is content; content goes behind a reference.

successorKey.description: A public key: a registered algorithm and the key's bytes in strict padded base64.
